title.en: The steps of the scientific method

text.en:
Ravi wondered why a puddle dried faster in the sun than in the shade.
"Test it," said his teacher.

Scientists begin with a question, make a guess called a hypothesis, test it with an experiment, record what they see and draw a conclusion.
A fair test changes only one thing at a time. To test whether sunlight dries water faster, we keep the same amount of water and change only the place.
Repeating the experiment and sharing results helps others trust them.
